system.description:
The damage of your "Pulse Bullet" is increased by +2. A circlet adorned with a beetle shining in gold. It improves the rate of fire of the damage spells used by Enchanters, letting them rain down bullets of light like early-summer showers. Overlooked at first because of how plain it was, it became famous overnight with the appearance of "Sprinkler", an unusual build centered on this item.

Black Eye [Core Material] (440G) + Wind Reading Earring (400G) + Golden Peacock Talisman (410G) + [Magic Catalyst 15] (220G) ×2 + Crafting Cost (590G)
